CustomField.description: Duplicate Matching: which value wins on an auto-merge for every person field with no active Merge Rule row (C-51, canonical model R-DP8): Keep master, Not blank (the shipped choice, and what a blank means), Most recent, Oldest record or Most complete. Held as text because a custom setting field cannot be a picklist; the settings console offers the five values.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Which value wins on an auto-merge for a field with no merge rule of its own.
CustomField.label: Merge Rule For Other Fields
